root_cause.text: The mutex in `struct apple_smc` was not initialized before being used in `apple_smc_read()`, causing undefined behavior (occasional NULL pointer dereferences) when sub-device probe functions called that function.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `mutex_init(&smc->mutex);` in `apple_smc_probe()` (diff line "+	mutex_init(&smc->mutex);"). The commit message explicitly states that using the mutex uninitialized resulted in occasional NULL pointer dereferences in `apple_smc_read()` calls from sub-device probe functions.
